children: Beeline Holdings announced a collaboration with Emmy-winning Loft 100 Studios to produce a 45-minute “Bizumentary” on mortgage and homeownership challenges, with initial distribution reaching about 90 million viewers.
Beeline Holdings is producing a documentary-style “Bizumentary” with Loft 100 Studios examining mortgage affordability and industry challenges.
The 45-minute program combines documentary storytelling and industry perspectives on technology, alternative underwriting and home equity solutions.
Initial national distribution starts the week of Sept. 21 on BizTV, American Life Network and American Forces Network, reaching ~90 million viewers.
Program may be picked up by larger networks as it gains exposure, potentially expanding audience and company visibility.
